The feat's actual payload — trading a prepared wizard slot to infuse the shield, and the automatic heightening of the drained spell to the infused rank — is modelled by neither side, so a Spellshield holder gets Arcane Bond and nothing that

The dedication's parenthetical replacement clause is delivered by neither side: a character already expert in all four listed skills picks a dead option and gains nothing, where print gives them expert in two other skills they are trained i

The feat's entire printed effect is unmodelled on our side — the record carries no degreeShifts, no situationalBonuses entry and no recordMarks — so a holder's Nature row and the Command an Animal action row say nothing, while WG delivers t
Basic Modification grants an inventor-archetype character a basic modification of their choice, but the app offers no picker at all for an archetype inventor, so the feat delivers nothing.

Neither of Eerie Environs' two mechanics — Demoralizing without losing hidden, and waiving the no-shared-language penalty — reaches the player anywhere in the app except the feat's own description text.
Greater Cruelty's clause never reaches the Cruelty spell, although the app already has the exact lane for it and the prerequisite feat Cruelty uses that lane on the very same spell.

The digest's "MISSING hp | theirs=3 | ours=(nothing)" flag on Monk Moves is an instrument misread: WG's +3 HP op sits inside a conditional gated on owning a DIFFERENT feat (Monk Resiliency), which our feats/monk-resiliency delivers itself,

Monk Moves' +10-foot Speed is delivered twice on our side: the evaluated speedsIf already adds it to the Speed number while unarmored, and a situationalBonuses star advertises the same +10 as if it were still to be applied.

Our Advanced Domain picker offers the advanced spell of ALL 64 domains instead of only the domains the character actually has an initial domain spell for, so a cleric of a Fire/Zeal deity can take Localized Quake or Door to Beyond.

Our record tags Advanced Domain as a soul-warden archetype feat at level 8, but print lists it on three archetypes at two different levels — Soul Warden at 16, Vindicator at 8, Campfire Chronicler at 8 — and because the record carries no 'a

The Free Action cost belongs to the granted Entreat Pact action, not to the feat, and our record carries it in both places — the feat renders with a free-action glyph although it is a passive feat that only grants an action.

Murksight's Perception clause has no carrier on our side at all — the record is a bare passive feat with no situationalBonuses entry — while Wanderer's Guide attaches the note to the Perception statistic.
Flickering Stories changes what the Offer Story action can do, and our side attaches nothing to that action row; Wanderer's Guide injects the alternate benefit onto Offer a Story at point of use.

Dream Magic grants its chosen spell at the spell's BASE rank instead of the printed 4th rank, so a character who picks Sleep casts a 1st-rank Sleep and one who picks Dream Message casts a 3rd-rank Dream Message.
Dream Magic prints its own spellcasting profile (trained in spell attack/DC, Wisdom) and we carry no spellcastingGrant, so the spell is cast off the innate entry's default Charisma.
Dream Magic is maxTakable 2 and the second taking grants nothing: the pick lane stores one answer per feat id, so the player cannot end up with both spells.

The qi spell this feat grants delivers no mechanics at all: the shadow grasp Strike the printed text names is not created by any carrier, and the stance itself has no toggle, because stance defs are keyed by feat/action id and no entry exis
Our sheet description restricts the counteract to Clumsy 1 and Enfeebled 1, while print names the clumsy or enfeebled conditions with no value — a player with clumsy 2 reads ours as ineligible.

The feat's always-on +5-foot status bonus to Speeds has no numeric carrier on our side — the record's only carrier is a display star in situationalBonuses.ts, so a swashbuckler-archetype character's Speed never changes on the sheet with or

Our shipped description is the LEGACY Advanced Player's Guide text (feat-1864) with the word "panache" deleted, on a record whose own aonId is the remaster feat-6238 — the player reads "with or without ." instead of the Player Core 2 senten
The second half of the feat — the skill feat the morning's pick also grants — is prose only on our side: WG asks for it as a real feat selection, we print it in choice.note and grant nothing.

The NO-SHEET-EFFECT flag is an instrument artefact: the harness built this cleric class-archetype feat on a FIGHTER host, so the entry its spellSlotBonus names ('cleric-casting') did not exist and the two creed slots had nowhere to land; on

The feat's whole mechanic — +2 temporary gadgets per day — has no carrier on either side, and neither does the base count it increases, so an inventor who takes it gets nothing and has no gadget-per-day figure anywhere in the app.

The stance the feat grants delivers nothing but a repertoire line: content.stances has no 'wild-winds-stance' entry, so neither the wind crash ranged Strike nor the +2 circumstance AC against ranged attacks ever reaches the sheet — and beca

Sinister Knight is an armour property rune with no entry in core.json `runes`, so it can never be etched onto heavy armour and its +1 Deception only fires if the player mislabels the loose rune as worn/equipped.
The cloak's once-per-hour activation grants a fly Speed and neither side carries it, although the app's modes lane already models the identical clause on comparable items.
The cold robe's once-per-day activation grants the effects of water walk for 1 minute and neither side carries it, although the fire variant's activation clause does have a carrier.
